title: No-PIV sent_response commit precedes encryption permanently refusing identical retry after AEAD fault
description: oscore_protect.c:721 commits sent_response correlation before encrypt :742; encrypt-fail retry then REPLAY-refused. Judged safe/fails-closed (matches lost-response; real retransmissions refused earlier by replay_reserve_pending) but commit is infallible RAM op under held mutex: moving after successful encrypt eliminates residual preserving zero-caller-bytes. Recommendation-grade improvement.
close_reason: Moved the no-PIV sent_response correlation commit in protect_response (oscore_protect.c) from before the AEAD call to AFTER successful lichen_aes_ccm_encrypt. The commit is still an infallible RAM write under the same continuously-held mutex (the no-PIV path locks at identity binding and never releases until cleanup), and the acceptability gate still runs under that same hold, so no concurrent commit can interleave; the commit simply now cannot precede the last fallible step. Failure semantics preserved exactly: zero-caller-bytes guarantee untouched (encrypt remains the only caller-buffer writer; sentinel-prefill check proves ct/opt untouched on fault), and on OSCORE_ERR_ENCRYPT_FAILED the window is now left UNCHANGED so a genuine retry of the identical correlation succeeds - this is the intended improvement (previously permanently REPLAY-refused). Re-ran the response-replay bit-exact harness pattern from prior review (temp dir oscmargin-verify, REAL oscore TUs + vendored monocypher + tinycrypt AES-CCM linked under renamed symbols reached through fault-injectable forwarders, stub zephyr headers, ASan+UBSan). Output pasted: 1: no-PIV response OK (ct_len=9, opt_len=0) / 1: duplicate correlation refused REPLAY (committed once) / [fault] encrypt call #4 injected failure / 2: AEAD fault -> ENCRYPT_FAILED, zero caller bytes (ct/opt sentinels intact) / 3: genuine retry after fault OK (would be REPLAY pre-1o6h) / 3: retry ciphertext BIT-EXACT to never-faulted oracle (9 bytes) / 4: post-retry duplicate refused REPLAY (commit-after-encrypt holds) / 5: with_piv path still bit-exact across sibling contexts / RESPONSE-REPLAY HARNESS OK. The bit-exact oracle is an independent twin context with identical master/IDs that never faulted - retry output equals what the first attempt would have produced. SECURITY comment at the encrypt site updated to describe the new ordering; also folded in the w9fw fresh-PIV margin wording (rollback equality check self-disables after the margin advance, skipped sequences never reused). Syntax matrix clean across all 7 oscore TUs at PT_MAX 256/2048 x MAX_CONTEXTS 8/32.
